tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find, compare, or buy Pokémon card listings on eBay. Active eBay listings for Pokémon cards with every pokefocus.com/listings filter: card search, cards or set, grade, era, rarity, centering, price, free shipping, listing checks (tags), seller feedback, seller locatio

tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Use this when the user names or describes a Pokémon card and wants to identify it or see its price. Finds Pokémon cards the way the pokefocus.com search box does, best match first. Each card has its id, TCGplayer market price, 30-day raw and PSA 10 eBay sold medians and sale counts, image, card page

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a specific Pokémon card is worth or has sold for, raw or graded. One card as its pokefocus.com page shows it: TCGplayer market price with 7- and 30-day change, eBay sold medians and sale counts for raw, PSA 9, and PSA 10, active listing count, and the verified recent

tools.name: search_sets
tools.description: Use this when the user names a Pokémon TCG set or asks which sets exist. Sets by name or code, or every set newest first. Each set has its id, code, release date, logo, and its card list and sealed product pages on pokefocus.com.

tools.name: get_set
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about the most valuable cards, card prices, or sealed products in a set. One Pokémon TCG set as pokefocus.com shows it: its cards with TCGplayer market prices (most valuable first by default) and its sealed products with market price, lowest listing, pack count, and price

tools.name: search_sealed
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about booster boxes, Elite Trainer Boxes, bundles, tins, or other sealed Pokémon products. Sealed products with their id, TCGplayer market price, set, image, and product page.

tools.name: get_sealed_product
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a specific sealed Pokémon product costs, is worth, or works out to per pack. One sealed product as its pokefocus.com page shows it: TCGplayer market price with 7- and 30-day change, lowest listing and listing count, pack count and price per pack, and 30 days of daily

tools.name: get_market_pulse
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how the Pokémon card market is moving, which cards or sets are up or down, or for today's market report. PokeFocus Market Pulse, the daily Pokémon card market report: headline, 7-day direction, cards up and down, and each section's summary with the cards or sealed product
